names.description: The field's instrument approach charts (IAP) by their d-TPP names, "ILS OR LOC RWY 27", "RNAV (GPS) RWY 9"; the engine decides which are precision (precision_approach: ILS, GLS, PAR, AIM 5-4-5 a.7(a)).

approaches.description: The field's instrument approaches as the d-TPP lists them: their names, and its nonstandard alternate minimums page.

covers.description: taf_window's worst.covers: whether the TAF covers the whole window. Missing is taken as not.

forecast.description: The worst its TAF forecasts over the window (taf_window's worst, with its `covers`), null where the field has no TAF or none says anything of the window.
